critical_code_review_comments: LeadService::capture properly guards concurrent race via dedupe_key + QueryException catch — force=true intentionally sets key=null bypassing the guard so duplicate-force still creates.

AutomationController::store validates actions as required array but does not validate per-action shape (type/title/due_in_hours). Frontend builder enforces schema, but any raw POST could store malformed actions. Consider server-side per-action validation.

LeadController::addStakeholder: is_primary demotes all previous entries — good. However there's no server-side validation preventing duplicate phones across stakeholders and no explicit index bounds error on removeStakeholder (silently no-ops on invalid index — safe but not observable).
LeadController::switchProject uses AuditService via LeadService — activity log entry title contains 'Project switched'. Verified in timeline.
AutomationController::logs supports ?lead_id + ?status filter (was noted missing in prev iteration; already fixed).
config.js autoForm structured builder replaces JSON textarea (per requirement); no JSON input rendered — verified visually.
leads.js interestsPanel adds stakeholders/units/switch-project into Qualify tab — clean binding using api.post/api.del.

rca of the issue: N/A — all R2 acceptance passes. Concurrency guarantee RCA: LeadService::capture computes normalized dedupe_key (last-10 phone digits or lowercased email), attempts INSERT, and on QueryException (unique-index violation from concurrent race) returns the winning lead. Verified: 8 parallel POSTs → exactly 1 x 201 + 7 x 409, and DB contains exactly 1 lead with the phone. Force flow sets key=null, bypassing constraint — verified second lead created.
